description.message: Unwraps YouTube redirect and sponsored links to the real destination without URL trackers.

allowlist_desc.message: Links to these domains stay unchanged. This is useful for sites that need their parameters to work, like some ad networks. Subdomains are included, so $1 also covers $2.

allow_empty.message: No domains added yet. All links are cleaned.

error_not_domain.message: That doesn't look like a valid domain.
